name: lupper
description: Review email and SMS results in Lupper, compare periods, summarize what worked, and create email drafts, SMS drafts, segments, and automation drafts. Sending always needs a person to approve it in the Lupper app.

interface.longDescription:
See how your email marketing performs in Lupper and prepare the next send, without leaving ChatGPT.

View results: Show email campaign results with opens, clicks, and revenue per campaign. Also see SMS campaign results and automation performance, and list onsite campaigns.

Compare over time: Compare one period with the previous one and get a plain summary of current and earlier results, including what worked best.

Create drafts (write access): Save an email draft as blocks in the visual editor, with a subject, an optional template, and an optional segment. Save SMS drafts, create segments, and build automations as drafts from a template. A person reviews every draft in Lupper.

Look up your data: Find profiles, segments, orders, products, and events for the companies you allow.

Sending stays with you: ChatGPT can check a draft and ask for approval, and a person approves the send in the Lupper app. The connection never sends a campaign, starts an automation, or publishes onsite on its own. You choose read-only or write access when you connect.
defaultPrompt: Show last week's email campaigns with open rate, click rate, and revenue per campaign.
Compare email campaigns from the last 30 days with the 30 days before, including opens, clicks, and revenue.
Write an email draft in Lupper announcing our summer sale, with a clear subject and a button to the shop.
